preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s) for n, s in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5, even) followed by a binary string s of length n, where s_i ∈ {0,1}.
The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 2·10^5.

postconditions.description: The first line of output for each test case is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether a solution exists.

postconditions.expression:
(stdout.strip() == 'YES') == any(
    (all(a[i] == b[i] if s[i] == '1' else a[i] != b[i] for i in range(n)) and
     is_balanced(a) and is_balanced(b))
    for a, b, s, n in parse_test_cases(stdin))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the next two lines contain balanced bracket sequences a and b of length n such that for all 1 ≤ i ≤ n, a_i == b_i if s_i == '1', and a_i != b_i if s_i == '0'. If 'NO', no such sequences exist.

postconditions.expression: all(len(a) == len(b) == n for a, b, s, n in parse_test_cases(stdin) if 'YES' in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: When 'YES' is output, the sequences a and b must each have length exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(is_balanced(a) and is_balanced(b) for a, b, s, n in parse_test_cases(stdin) if 'YES' in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The sequences a and b must be balanced bracket sequences (can be turned into valid math expressions by adding '+' and '1').
